source: Turner et al. 2012, Bulletin of the American Museum of Natural History 371, Fig. 5: a generalized cladogram of birds; slanted, root at the upper left, thin lines, a skeletal drawing beside each tip. Half the tips are clade names, not taxa (Enantiornithes, Hesperornithiformes, Paleognathae, Neognathae); the others are genera.
